items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of 'Mr. Watson' in Abbey Lincoln's speech or in the interviewer's questions directed at her. The text labeled 'MR. WATSON' appears to be a separate speaker or transcription artifact not interacting with the interviewee.

ctx.x: We definitely want to talk about Verve and also I want to talk about the films, but I think we should do that tomorrow.
Okay. MR. WATSON: We've been talking about just the sound of the voice and how that sound communicates something to the audience and how it changes the audience, how -­
Yeah. MR. WATSON: And I'd just like to hear you talk about that.
